name: Ding Ling
shortBio: Chinese feminist writer and social critic whose May Fourth and Yan’an essays exposed psychological contradictions of female desire and the persistence of patriarchal hierarchy within revolutionary socialist institutions.
centralQuestion: Why do revolutionary movements that promise class emancipation continue to enforce patriarchal double standards against women’s intellectual and sexual autonomy?

keyWorks.title: Miss Sophia's Diary (Shafei Nüshi de Riji)
keyWorks.description: Psychological exploration of modern female subjectivity, desire, and alienation in Republican Beijing.

keyWorks.title: Thoughts on March 8 (Sanbajie Yougan)
keyWorks.description: Courageous socialist-feminist critique of gender hypocrisy and political repression inside Yan’an.
